summary: Retested every iteration_3 fix through the public URL. All 6 requested fixes work in both backend and UI. Backend regression run per file with -n 0: 62/62 passed (test_extras 6, iteration2 6, iteration3 10, iteration4 8, iteration5 6 (new), landvilla_api 15, marketplace 5, seed 6). UI checks at 390x844: (1) The buyer enquiry badge shows Sent, then stays Sent after the lister sets follow_up, then shows Replied, then Closed. follow_up_at and notes are not in the buyer payload. (2) In admin /admin/reports, 'Mark completed' and 'Reject' each remove a card (3, then 2, then 1) and show the 'Request updated' toast. A second close of the same request returns 404, and non-admins get 403. (3) The 3rd delete-account request for the same email (case-insensitive) returns 'Request already received', and only 2 are stored. (4) The resolve sheet shows 'Note: String should have at least 3 characters', and the report badge reads 'wrong info'. (5) Block shows Block, then 'Tap to confirm', then Unblock with a toast. When a blocked buyer sends a message, the composer is hidden and thread-blocked-notice appears. (6) The featured order without the header returns 403 with the exact message, X-LV-Client: android also returns 403, and web returns 503. All web fetches carry X-LV-Client: web. The UI order call itself was not reached because the feature screen shows 'payments-not-configured' first. Home, property detail, Saved and Profile load with no console errors. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the files checked.

minor.issue: A buyer can still message a lead after the lister closed it (200), and the status stays 'closed'. The lister may never see the new message. Consider reopening the lead (set it to 'new'/'contacted') or flagging unread messages.

The web-only gate trusts a client header that anyone can set. This meets the store-policy goal (the native app never sends 'web'), but it is not a security control. Server-side checks (listing ownership/active, signature verify) remain the real guard, and they are in place.

ui_bugs.issue: Blocked state is held only in local component state. After a reload, a blocked buyer sees the composer again, and the notice only returns after another failed send. The lister's button shows 'Block' again after a reload even though the block is active. Return is_blocked/blocked_by_me from GET /enquiries/{id} and /leads/{id}, and initialise from it.
'Mark completed'/'Reject' run on a single tap with no confirmation and a hardcoded note. The buttons are not disabled while the mutation is pending, so a double tap gives a 404 error toast.

action_items: Optional: expose block state in the GET enquiry/lead responses so the composer, notice and Block/Unblock label survive a reload.
Optional: reopen or flag a closed lead when the buyer sends a new message.
Optional: disable the deletion-request buttons while the request is pending, and add a confirm step.
Still open from iteration 3: marketplace.py is over 700 lines; split it into modules.
test_iteration4_public_e2e.py leaves test_del_* deletion requests in the DB. Add deletion_requests cleanup (iteration 5 cleans its own data).
critical_code_review_comments: In buyer_enquiry, the buyer status is derived from the lister's messages and the closed state. It is correct, and the lister CRM status is unchanged in /leads.
The delete-account rate limit is 2 per email per 24h plus 100 per hour globally. The global cap could let an attacker block real users for an hour; a per-IP limit would be better.
api.ts maps the Pydantic loc to field names correctly. Only the last loc segment is used, which is fine for flat bodies.
seed_data_creation: The UI seed (tests/ui_seed_iter5.py) created a temporary owner listing, an enquiry, a report and deletion requests. All were removed with 'cleanup'. Leftover test_* deletion requests were also deleted. Seeded test users were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend per file with -n 0. The iteration 5 test imports helpers from test_iteration4_public_e2e. A buyer can send only one enquiry per property per 24h (409), so reuse the enquiry. Python urllib calls from inside browser_automation get 403 from the ingress, so make API side-calls from bash curl. On web, set localStorage auth_token, then goto. The feature screen shows payments-not-configured without calling the order endpoint, so verify the header by sniffing requests.
